description: Set hard caps on agent spending. Any field you pass is updated; omitted fields stay unchanged. Useful for guardrails against runaway agent costs — e.g. daily=20 caps spend at $20/day. Pass perTx=null to clear the per-transaction limit.

daily.description: Max USDC spendable per UTC day (defaults to $100). Set to 0 to disable spending.

monthly.description: Max USDC spendable per calendar month (defaults to $1000). Must be >= daily.

perTx.description: Max USDC per single send. null to clear (no per-tx cap).

name: spawnpay_budget_set
